violated_contract: A recurring durable-obligation scanner must eventually discover actionable work beyond a full page of blocked obligations. Repeatedly querying only the oldest page can deadlock the dependencies needed to clear that page.
canonical_prevention: Advance independent bounded keyset cursors for independent drains, wrap at exhaustion, and retain transaction-level authorization, ordering and idempotency fences. Reproduce a full blocked page plus actionable dependencies beyond it against the real store.
